description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to authentication endpoints, including request and response data structures.

classes.name: AuthDtos
classes.description: Container class for authentication-related DTOs, including registration request, login request, and authentication response records.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Data record for user registration requests, including validation constraints for input fields.

methods.name: LoginRequest
methods.description: Data record for login requests, including validation constraints.

methods.name: AuthResponse
methods.description: Data record for authentication responses containing token and user information.
